description: The shell needs its own commands, plus opener to reveal the startup report in Explorer and open the data folder when a support email is being put together. The scope is $RESOURCE, the resource directory the app resolves its own root and data folder from (main.rs app_dir/data_dir), NOT a named install path - the install location is the user's choice at install time, and a hard-coded one silently stopped matching the moment it moved. The UI itself is served over http from the local backend and needs no Tauri APIs.
